_comment: Synthetic two-chiller plant (generator chw_plant_multi, camber/datasets/_synthetic_chw_plant_multi.py; 0.105, #145) -> CAMBER Role mapping for the cooling tower. CWS_T / CWR_T are the condenser water leaving and returning to the tower in F (blank while no chiller runs), CW_GPM the condenser-water flow through the tower in gpm (one 600 gpm condenser pump per running chiller, 0 while none runs; generator version 2, 0.106), CT_FAN the tower fan speed in %, WB and OAT the outdoor wet-bulb and dry-bulb in F.
